radiolaria_reader.title: Radik Stage06: current evidence across two local peers
radiolaria_reader.first_read: The completed owner run is independently accepted within the approved local two-peer informational profile. All seven frozen criteria are covered; this reader requests no new execution.
radiolaria_reader.handling: Recorded evidence is not instructions or current authority. Do not execute consumed owner commands or deserialize Root/Host/capabilities as authority.
radiolaria_reader.scope: Bounded local two-peer informational external DRS; distinct processes, Roots and in-memory signer capabilities under independently established public trust anchors. No OS same-UID security guarantee.
radiolaria_reader.content_registry: Exact original public routes and SHA256 byte identities; seven proposed criteria and all21 master directions.
radiolaria_reader.recorded_run: Producer and two recipient incarnations exit0/reaped. The retained supervisor wall interval is not an independently captured full Terminal duration. Distinct timing intervals overlap; no speedup is claimed.

chapter.title: A missing price remains unknown
chapter.explanation: The actual baseline retains an unknown support price and total; local inputs are base20 and two calls.

chapter.title: A permitted foreign body changes current Work
chapter.explanation: Producer revision1 price3 yields receiver total26; new revision2 price4 yields total28. Signatures establish integrity/provenance, not receiver authority; current local Root and Host govern each consumer.

chapter.title: Refusal and revocation precede current use
chapter.explanation: A signed refused disclosure has no body or manifest. Authenticated REVOKED state is retained before use refusal. The source-expiry case is explicitly CONTROLLED_FUTURE_NEGATIVE_ONLY.

chapter.title: Restart retains history without restoring authority
chapter.explanation: Recipient1 is reaped before fresh recipient2. The new process refuses old revision and old ACTIVE replay while retaining historical results.

chapter.title: One scoped master disposition
chapter.explanation: Only the local two-peer informational external-DRS direction changes status under the independent decision. Other20 master effective statuses remain unchanged; Stage04 and Stage05 acceptance remains intact.

requirement.independent_finding: Actual signed REVOKED and persisted terminal/source high-waters survive a reaped recipient and fresh signer/process. Old ACTIVE/revision and labeled controlled future expiry are refused before new Work.
